mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) triggers accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 100,000 monthly jobs) consistently drives consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 105 indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1150) reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1150.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal tightening monetary policy amid rising inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously.
